Written practice and clear reasoning

Unit 1 · Week 16 · Lesson 1 · Suggested 55-minute plan; adjust to local timing.

Prepare: Open the exam-preparation chapter and its learning resources. Use paper or a local editor as appropriate, with fictional data and disposable practice copies. The suggested 55-minute lesson is flexible.

Suggested answers are teacher guidance, not extra assessment tasks. These notes are public.

1. Written practice and clear reasoning

Suggested time: 2 minutes

Instructional strategy: Learning intention

Explain the goal and the expected independent outcome. Explain your method on an original revision sample. This is ungraded textbook learning. Suggested times can be adjusted to the class. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#exam-preparation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

2. Retrieval and explanation

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Individual retrieval, then partner comparison

Explain links a mechanism to an outcome. Trace records changing state in order. Use the supplied task instructions and current course guidance. Allow silent thinking before discussion. Ask a learner to justify an answer before revealing the explanation. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#exam-preparation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

3. A written response plan

Suggested time: 6 minutes

Instructional strategy: Worked table and teacher explanation

Use the original Unit 1 practice paper as optional revision. It is not an official paper or a grade predictor. No marks need recording. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#exam-preparation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

4. The Q3 maximum trace

Suggested time: 10 minutes

Instructional strategy: Predict, model and explain

Index 0, maximum 6 and total 10. Equality keeps the first maximum. Empty input requires checking before reading element zero. Pause for predictions before discussing the expected result. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#exam-preparation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

5. Reading a compound question

Suggested time: 10 minutes

Instructional strategy: Guided paired practice

Q3 requests more than a largest value. Model checking every requested part without implying a marking allocation. Swap explaining and checking roles so both learners articulate the reasoning. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#exam-preparation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

6. Independent practice

Suggested time: 12 minutes

Instructional strategy: Independent application with optional support

Use questions-only file first and explained answers afterwards. Timing is optional and should fit class needs. No scoring or submission requirement. Offer the relevant worked example if needed, then use a changed case to check independent understanding. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#exam-preparation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

7. A choice to explain

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Whole-class response and justification

B. Answer the actual requirement. A value and its location are different outputs. Give thinking time and collect reasons, without recording scores. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#exam-preparation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

8. Exit explanation

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Individual reflection and fresh explanation

Use the specific question and missing reasoning step to plan feedback, not a numeric ranking. Use the response to select the next explanation or practice activity. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#exam-preparation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.
